sentences.zh: 今天，我们将深入了解俄勒冈州波特兰市动荡的局势，以及为什么联邦部队会被部署到美国各个城市。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月23日，星期四。

sentences.en: Colin Kano-Youngs, you covered the Department of Homeland Security for The Times, the entire universe of federal law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 科林·卡诺-杨斯，你曾为《时报》报道过国土安全部，以及整个联邦执法部门的相关事务。

sentences.en: So where does the story of what's happening right now in Portland, where does it start?
sentences.zh: 那么，现在波特兰发生的事情，这个故事是从哪里开始的呢？

sentences.en: So I think we have to go back to late May.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须回到5月下旬。

sentences.en: In late May, as we know, there were protests sweeping throughout the country, mass demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，5月下旬，抗议活动席卷全国，爆发了大规模示威。

sentences.en: A majority of those protests involved people who were demonstrating peacefully.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动中，绝大多数参与者都是在和平示威。

sentences.en: But you did also have instances of people damaging property, looting, as well as acts of violence.
sentences.zh: 但确实也出现了一些人破坏财产、抢劫以及实施暴力行为的情况。

sentences.en: And in Oakland, you had a situation where an officer with the Federal Protective Service, an arm of the Department of Homeland Security, who was guarding a
sentences.zh: 在奥克兰，曾发生过一起事件：一名联邦保护局（国土安全部的一个分支机构）的官员在守卫

sentences.en: federal courthouse, was actually shot and killed.
sentences.zh: 联邦法院时被枪杀。

sentences.en: I should say that the person who shot and killed him was actually affiliated with a fringe anti-government movement and wasn't affiliated with the protests.
sentences.zh: 我应该说明的是，枪杀他的那个人实际上与一个边缘反政府组织有关，并非抗议活动的参与者。

sentences.en: But that killing did prompt a rare press conference.
sentences.zh: 但那次杀戮确实引发了一场罕见的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security's highest priority is to ensure the safety and security of the American people and the department's workforce.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部的首要任务是确保美国人民和部门工作人员的安全与保障。

sentences.en: From the top senior officials from the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 来自国土安全部的高层官员们。

sentences.en: Any loss in the DHS family impacts all of us.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部大家庭的任何损失都影响着我们每一个人。

sentences.en: And I want the loved ones of these brave officers to know that you have the support of the department behind you.
sentences.zh: 我想让这些勇敢官员的亲人们知道，你们有整个部门作为后盾。

sentences.en: They go out there and, of course, they honor the memory of this officer, but they also have a message.
sentences.zh: 他们走上街头，当然是为了纪念这位官员，但他们也传达了一个信息。

sentences.en: There are currently threats by some to attack police stations and federal buildings.
sentences.zh: 目前有人威胁要袭击警察局和联邦大楼。

sentences.en: That violence not only won't be tolerated, we are also committed to ensuring that it won't succeed
sentences.zh: 这种暴力行为不仅不会被容忍，我们还致力于确保它不会在

sentences.en: anywhere, anywhere.
sentences.zh: 任何地方，任何地方得逞。

sentences.en: And let me be clear.
sentences.zh: 让我把话说清楚。

sentences.en: They make it clear that they are going to take action against anybody that makes a threat or has any sort of action against federal property.
sentences.zh: 他们明确表示，将对任何发出威胁或对联邦财产采取任何行动的人采取行动。

sentences.en: The acting deputy secretary, Kenneth Cuccinelli, even says.
sentences.zh: 代理副部长肯尼斯·库奇内利甚至说：

sentences.en: That is an act of domestic terrorism.
sentences.zh: 那是国内恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: That would be an act of domestic terrorism.
sentences.zh: 那将是一种国内恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And so why is that phrase significant, domestic terrorism?
sentences.zh: 那么，“国内恐怖主义”这个词为什么意义重大？

sentences.en: The reason why this is significant is you have to remember how this department was created.
sentences.zh: 之所以意义重大，是因为你必须记住这个部门是如何成立的。

sentences.en: In the wake of the September 11th attacks, this department was formed in the Bush administration
sentences.zh: 在“9·11”恐怖袭击之后，布什政府成立了这个部门，

sentences.en: to have a coordinated effort in the federal government to defend the United States against national security threats.
sentences.zh: 旨在协调联邦政府的努力，以保卫美国免受国家安全威胁。

sentences.en: Directly at that time, foreign terrorism threats.
sentences.zh: 当时直接针对的是外国恐怖主义威胁。

sentences.en: This was a department that was going to protect the borders of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是一个旨在保护美国边境的部门。

sentences.en: And this signaled that the top officials in that department were turning their attention inward, domestically, to these protests that are sweeping major cities.
sentences.zh: 而这标志着该部门的高层官员正将注意力转向国内，转向席卷各大城市的这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: So what happens after this news conference, which from what you're describing feels like more of a statement than a set of actions?
sentences.zh: 那么在那次新闻发布会之后发生了什么？在你看来，那似乎更像是一份声明，而不是一系列行动？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think at that point, it's a message.
sentences.zh: 我认为在那个时候，这是一种信号。

sentences.en: The message is we're not going to tolerate this.
sentences.zh: 信号就是：我们不会容忍这种行为。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: It's clear.
sentences.zh: 很清楚。

sentences.en: But then things start to move pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 但随后局势开始迅速发展。

sentences.en: Within two days, on June 1st, we start to see that the department is going to back up this rhetoric with the concrete action of federal resources.
sentences.zh: 两天之内，即6月1日，我们开始看到该部门将用联邦资源的具体行动来支持这种言论。

sentences.en: I remember early in the day, you know, I got a message from a source who sent me an alert that all Homeland Security investigation special agents around the Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 我记得那天早些时候，我收到了一条消息来源发来的警报，所有华盛顿特区周边的国土安全调查特工都收到了。

sentences.en: area got.
sentences.zh: 警报称：你们必须待命，以应对今天晚些时候拉斐特公园周边可能发生的任何动乱。

sentences.en: And it said, you have to be on standby for any potential unrest later today around the area of Lafayette Park.
sentences.zh: 所以那天晚些时候，你看到了特勤局、缉毒局、国民警卫队、

sentences.en: So that day, you know, later on, that's where you saw the images of Secret Service, DEA, National Guard,
sentences.zh: 海关及边境保护局，还有移民及海关执法局的画面。

sentences.en: Customs and Border Protection, Immigration and Customs Enforcement as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，正是许多同样的联邦官员和特工驻扎在拉斐特公园外，

sentences.en: And of course, it was many of those same federal officials and agents who were stationed outside of Lafayette Park
sentences.zh: 并清除了抗议者，为总统的拍照活动腾出空间。

sentences.en: and would clear out protesters to make room for the president's photo op.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在看到那次新闻发布会上发出的信号，正在华盛顿街头付诸实践。

sentences.en: So we're now seeing the message delivered at that news conference put into action on the streets of Washington.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你听听国土安全部高级官员，

sentences.en: And I mean, if you listen to the senior officials with the Department of Homeland Security,
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普政府其他官员的说法，他们会说，看，华盛顿需要这种联邦力量的存在。

sentences.en: as well as other officials in the Trump administration, they would say, look, this federal presence was needed in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我们在白宫前的特工受到了威胁。

sentences.en: Our agents in front of the White House were being threatened.
sentences.zh: 他们还会说，你看，大约一周后，动乱就平息了。

sentences.en: And they would also say, well, look, after about a week, the unrest calmed down.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 所以从他们的角度来看，尽管其中一些行动极具争议，且在现场感觉极具威慑力且不同寻常，但这是有效的。

sentences.en: So from their perspective, as controversial as some of these actions were and as intimidating and unusual as it felt on the ground, this was working.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 它奏效了。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 如果你去问他们，他们的部署奏效了。

sentences.en: Their deployment worked, if you were to ask them.
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 好的，在接下来的几周里，真正发生的是我们看到了转变。

sentences.en: OK, so over the next few weeks, what really happened is we saw a shift.
sentences.zh: 当抗议者试图推倒前总统安德鲁·杰克逊的雕像时，与警察发生了紧张的对峙。

sentences.en: A tense standoff with police as protesters tried to tear down a statue of former President Andrew Jackson.
sentences.zh: 现在我们开始看到抗议者和示威者将目标锁定并集中在雕像和纪念碑上。

sentences.en: Now we're starting to see protesters and demonstrators honing in and focusing on statues and memorials.
sentences.zh: 我们终于在解决白人至上主义问题了。

sentences.en: We're addressing white supremacy, finally.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们从小就习以为常的东西。

sentences.en: And it's just something that we grew up with.
sentences.zh: 它已经变得如此正常化，以至于出现在我们货币上的人曾经拥有过我。

sentences.en: And it's just been so normalized that the people on our money would have owned me.
sentences.zh: 针对那些雕像和纪念碑，有时推倒它们，有时损毁它们。

sentences.en: Targeting those statues and memorials, sometimes pulling them down, sometimes defacing them.
sentences.zh: 你也看到了联邦政府相当迅速的反应。

sentences.en: And you also saw a pretty prompt reaction by the federal government.

sentences.en: They don't love our country.
sentences.zh: 他们不能拆除我们的纪念碑。

sentences.en: And they're not taking down our monuments.

sentences.en: So in late June, I will have an executive order very shortly.
sentences.zh: 总统随后签署了一项行政命令。

sentences.en: The president then signs an executive order.
sentences.zh: 其要点大致是要求司法部长以及国土安全部代理部长，

sentences.en: The gist of it pretty much says that the attorney general, as well as the acting secretary of Homeland Security,
sentences.zh: 应调动资源来保卫雕像、纪念碑和联邦财产。

sentences.en: should direct their resources to defend statues and monuments and federal property.
sentences.zh: 仅仅几天后，国土安全部就成立了一个特别工作组，即所谓的“快速部署小组”。

sentences.en: Just a couple days later, the Department of Homeland Security then forms a task force, what's known as these rapid deployment teaMs.
sentences.zh: 这些小组包括2000名随时待命的官员和特工，从运输安全管理局的空中警员，到海关及边境保护局的战术特工，

sentences.en: Those teams involve 2,000 officers and agents that are on standby, from air marshals with the TSA, to tactical agents with Customs and Border Protection,
sentences.zh: 再到移民及海关执法局的特工，随时准备部署到美国各地。

sentences.en: to special agents with ICE, ready on standby to be deployed throughout the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的这种快速部署有多不寻常？

sentences.en: And how unusual is this kind of rapid deployment that you're describing?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，实际上，该部门成立时，许多前官员也会这样说，

sentences.en: Well, I mean, actually, the department, when it was formed, and many former officials with the department would say this as well,
sentences.zh: 那种能够灵活调动不同官员的能力是一种优势，对吧？

sentences.en: that flexibility to be able to move different officials around is an advantage, right?
sentences.zh: 让这些不同的机构能够相互支持，这本身也是一种初衷。

sentences.en: It was actually an intention as well to be able to have these different agencies support one another.
sentences.zh: 但这里的任务是部署他们去保护纪念碑和雕像，你知道，这些小组出现在国家广场和葛底斯堡前，

sentences.en: But it's the mission here, deploying them for monuments and statues, you know, the appearance of these teams in front of the National Mall and Gettysburg.
sentences.zh: 这让许多观察家以及该部门的一些设计者都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: That's where many observers, as well as some of the architects of the department, raised an eyebrow at this.
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 这个国家目前正面临几项不同的国家紧急情况。

sentences.en: This country is grappling with a couple different national emergencies right now.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部在应对疫情方面也承担着巨大的责任。

sentences.en: The Department of Homeland Security also has a huge stake in the response to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们还要举行选举。

sentences.en: We have an election coming up as well.
sentences.zh: 该部门是负责网络安全的机构。

sentences.en: The department is the agency tasked with cyber security.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个关于优先事项的问题。

sentences.en: So it was a question over priorities.
sentences.zh: 但对于该部门来说，归根结底是这一点：

sentences.en: But for the department, it really comes down to this.
sentences.zh: 这些人群中是否有人犯下了损毁联邦财产的联邦罪行？

sentences.en: Are any of these people in these crowds committing the federal crime of defacing federal property?
sentences.zh: 代理部长曾表示，他认为自己的职责是在出现任何违反联邦法律的行为时进行部署，

sentences.en: The acting secretary has said that he sees it as his job to deploy if there is any mere violation of that federal law,
sentences.zh: 无论是财产上的涂鸦，还是我们在这些示威活动中看到的一些更暴力的行为。

sentences.en: whether it be graffiti on a property or some of the more violent acts that we've seen in these demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 正是基于这种理由，该部门在那个周末，即7月4日的周末，开始将这些小组部署到不同的城市，但主要是部署到波特兰。

sentences.en: And it's that rationale that the department used, you know, that weekend, the weekend of July 4th, to start deploying these teams to different cities, but primarily to Portland.

sentences.zh: 在波特兰，有一些非常震撼的画面，人群覆盖了威拉米特河上整个伯恩赛德大桥，你知道，这是为了纪念乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: There are really powerful images here in Portland of crowds covering the entire Burnside Bridge over the Willamette River, you know, in honor of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你也看到了我们在许多城市看到的情况。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you've got what we saw in a lot of cities.
sentences.zh: 窗户被打碎。

sentences.en: Windows shattered.
sentences.zh: 到处都是涂鸦。

sentences.en: Graffiti everywhere.
sentences.zh: 砸碎商店的窗户。

sentences.en: Smashing windows of businesses.
sentences.zh: 有一家威瑞森商店。

sentences.en: There's a Verizon store.
sentences.zh: 耐克社区商店。

sentences.en: The Nike Community Store.
sentences.zh: 星巴克被砸了。

sentences.en: Starbucks got hit.
sentences.zh: 抗议的第一晚，他们闯入司法中心并放火。

sentences.en: The first night of protests, they broke into the Justice Center and lit fires.
sentences.zh: 但这里真正不同的是它的持续性。

sentences.en: But what's really been different here is the persistence of it.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动已经连续进行了50多天，每晚都在发生。

sentences.en: We're now more than 50 consecutive days into the protests happening every night.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: 50 days?
Like, non-stop?
sentences.zh: 你是说，没停过？

sentences.en: Non-stop.
sentences.zh: 没停过。

sentences.en: Every night.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上都这样。

sentences.en: And what have these nightly confrontations in Portland look like?
sentences.zh: 那么波特兰这些每晚发生的冲突是什么样子的？

sentences.en: You know, it's all over the place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，情况非常混乱。

sentences.en: You know, in some of these confrontations, many of which you can see in videos online, you know, you can see these standoffs between protesters and police where, you know,
sentences.zh: 在网上可以看到很多冲突视频，你可以看到抗议者和警察之间的对峙，你知道，

sentences.en: some protesters will throw water bottles or fireworks, videos of them breaking windows at buildings downtown or setting up barricades in the streets.
sentences.zh: 一些抗议者会投掷水瓶或烟花，视频里还有他们砸碎市中心建筑窗户或在街上设置路障的画面。

sentences.en: Police claim they've had bricks thrown at them, rocks thrown at them.
sentences.zh: 警方声称有人向他们投掷砖块和石块。

sentences.en: There have been videos surfacing online of people shooting guns in the air.
sentences.zh: 网上还出现了有人向空中开枪的视频。

sentences.en: One group set a fire in the headquarters of the police union, the local police union.
sentences.zh: 有一个团体在警察工会，也就是当地警察工会的总部放了火。

sentences.en: And throughout much of this time, they made it really their nightly routine to gather downtown right next to the federal courthouse.
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，他们把每晚聚集在市中心联邦法院旁边当作了例行公事。

sentences.en: This is the Portland Police Bureau.
sentences.zh: 这是波特兰警察局。

sentences.en: This is a civil disturbance and we have declared an unlawful assembly.
sentences.zh: 这是一场骚乱，我们已经宣布这是非法集会。

sentences.en: Leave the area now or you'll be subject to use of force to include crowd control munitions.
sentences.zh: 立即离开该区域，否则我们将采取武力手段，包括使用人群控制弹药。

sentences.en: Leave now.
sentences.zh: 现在就离开。

sentences.en: Police kept coming out, arresting a number of people.
sentences.zh: 警察不断出动，逮捕了许多人。

sentences.en: And responding with so much tear gas that some of these protesters went to court, sued, and won a judge's order limiting how much this gas could get used.
sentences.zh: 并以大量的催泪瓦斯作为回应，以至于一些抗议者诉诸法庭，起诉并赢得了法官的命令，限制了这种瓦斯的使用量。

sentences.en: Never seen or covered anything like this.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过或报道过这样的事情。

sentences.en: The damage and just the impact in the statement being made is unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这种破坏以及它所传达出的影响是前所未有的。

sentences.en: It's crazy to see.
sentences.zh: 这看起来太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's just been a persistent issue that they haven't really been able to resolve.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个他们一直无法真正解决的顽疾。

sentences.en: And who are the people who were involved in these nightly encounters, as best you can tell?
sentences.zh: 据你所知，参与这些每晚冲突的都是些什么人？

sentences.en: It's a group with a, you know, a wide range of backgrounds, ideologies, strategies, tactics that they've brought.
sentences.zh: 这是一个背景、意识形态、策略和战术都非常广泛的群体。

sentences.en: You know, Portland has a history of anarchist groups and you can see some of the anarchist symbols on the streets.
sentences.zh: 波特兰有无政府主义团体的历史，你可以在街上看到一些无政府主义的标志。

sentences.en: You know, you see a lot of people wearing all black clothing, which is pretty common for those who are part of the Antifa group.
sentences.zh: 你会看到很多人穿着全黑的衣服，这对于“反法西斯”（Antifa）组织的成员来说很常见。

sentences.en: And then you have people who are part of the Black Lives Matter movement chanting the name of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 然后还有“黑人的命也是命”（Black Lives Matter）运动的参与者，他们高呼着乔治·弗洛伊德的名字。

sentences.en: And just just so you really have this huge mix.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的是一个巨大的混合体。

sentences.en: Mike, in your time in Portland, I imagine you're talking to people in the city about this ongoing problem.
sentences.zh: 迈克，你在波特兰期间，我想你一定和城里的人谈过这个持续存在的问题。

sentences.en: What are people you've talked to in Portland saying about the situation?
sentences.zh: 你在波特兰交谈过的人们是怎么看待这种情况的？

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got, I mean, it seems like a pretty broad consensus of people who sympathize with
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，人们似乎达成了一个相当广泛的共识，他们同情

sentences.en: the overall message of the protesters, the need for police reform and the need for resolving racial injustices.
sentences.zh: 抗议者的总体诉求，即警察改革和解决种族不公的必要性。

sentences.en: At the same time, those same people are, you know, frustrated by what seems like a line of protests that won't seem to end.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这些人也对似乎永无止境的抗议活动感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Business people I talk to who, you know, have had their windows boarded up and shortened their hours for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的商界人士，他们的窗户被木板封住，为了安全缩短了营业时间。

sentences.en: And one of them I talk to is considering, like, maybe it's time to just get out of here because there doesn't seem to be a resolution ahead.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人跟我说，他正在考虑是不是该离开这里了，因为看起来根本看不到解决的希望。

sentences.en: We are physically and emotionally in pain.
sentences.zh: 我们在身体和情感上都承受着痛苦。

sentences.en: I have officers that are injured.
sentences.zh: 我有警员受伤了。

sentences.en: From police, you hear them saying essentially that they're out of ideas.
sentences.zh: 从警察那里，你听到他们基本上说自己已经束手无策了。

sentences.en: We love our community.
sentences.zh: 我们热爱我们的社区。

sentences.en: We want to serve our community and facilitate free speech.
sentences.zh: 我们想服务我们的社区，促进言论自由。

sentences.en: Saying that they're exhausted and in pain and they're trying to show that they're part of the community, too, that they aren't some sort of outside force that's here.
sentences.zh: 他们说自己精疲力竭，痛苦不堪，他们试图表明他们也是社区的一部分，而不是某种外来的强制力量。

sentences.en: We're at a loss for other solutions right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在对其他解决方案感到束手无策。

sentences.en: And I'm open to any community member who's got ideas for other solutions.
sentences.zh: 任何有其他解决方案想法的社区成员，我都愿意倾听。

sentences.en: We all are.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都一样。

sentences.en: So I have the sense at this point, correct me if I'm wrong, that the police don't quite know how to resolve these nightly encounters.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在的感觉是，如果我说错了请纠正我，警察似乎并不完全知道如何解决这些每晚的冲突。

sentences.en: And these nightly encounters are still happening.
sentences.zh: 而且这些每晚的冲突仍在发生。

sentences.en: And so is there some sense of resignation that this is just kind of how it is going to be for a while?
sentences.zh: 那么，人们是否有一种听天由命的感觉，认为在未来一段时间内情况就是这样了？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there's certainly no deadline that was going to be coming up.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，当然没有一个即将到来的截止日期。

sentences.en: There's a hope that that things were on a better track, that the numbers that were coming out each night were starting to to shrink a little bit and that, you know, there might
sentences.zh: 人们曾希望事情能走上正轨，每晚出来的人数开始减少，你知道，可能

sentences.en: be on a on a pathway to to finishing this.
sentences.zh: 正走在结束这一切的道路上。

sentences.en: And that's when a deployment of federal officers arrived in town.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，联邦官员被部署到了城里。

sentences.en: So what happens when those federal officials start showing up and at the direction of the
sentences.zh: 那么，当这些联邦官员在国土安全部的指挥下开始出现时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Department of Homeland Security?
sentences.zh: 国土安全部。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, right away, you can see that they're standing out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，你立刻就能看出他们很显眼。

sentences.en: I mean, they've shown up here in camouflage fatigues and tactical gear.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着迷彩服和战术装备出现在这里。

sentences.en: So just just visually, it's pretty clear that there's an outside force that has now arrived and they've come with a pretty aggressive posture.
sentences.zh: 所以从视觉上看，很明显有一股外部力量已经到达，而且他们采取了相当激进的姿态。

sentences.en: And what are these aggressive tactics from the federal forces there look like?
sentences.zh: 那么联邦部队这些激进的战术是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, some of it just, you know, in the streets, you can see a return to a large amount of tear
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一些，你知道，在街上，你可以看到大量催泪瓦斯的使用又回来了，

sentences.en: gas because, you know, these federal officers were not under the same mandates as local police.
sentences.zh: 因为这些联邦官员不受当地警察同样的指令约束。

sentences.en: But then there were also tactics that you could see coming out in different videos.
sentences.zh: 但随后还有一些你在不同视频中可以看到的战术。

sentences.en: In the first one, you have this protester standing across the street from the federal courthouse.
sentences.zh: 在第一个视频里，有一个抗议者站在联邦法院对面的街上。

sentences.en: He's, you know, he's he's got a boom box over his head and he's just cursing at the officers across the street.
sentences.zh: 他头上顶着一个音箱，对着街对面的警察咒骂。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, you see him drop to the ground.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你看到他倒在了地上。

sentences.en: He's apparently been shot with some sort of less lethal munition and really just created a bloody scene right there on the street, blood all over the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 他显然是被某种非致命性弹药击中了，现场立刻变得血腥，人行道上到处都是血。

sentences.en: And his family says he's had to go to the hospital for more than a week.
sentences.zh: 他的家人说他不得不在医院住了超过一周。

sentences.en: In these other videos, you have these protesters on the streets of Portland and federal officers,
sentences.zh: 在其他视频中，波特兰街头的抗议者和联邦官员，

sentences.en: again, in camouflage and tactical gear, approaching them, grabbing them and then pulling them back to unmarked vans.
sentences.zh: 同样穿着迷彩服和战术装备，接近他们，抓住他们，然后把他们拖进没有标记的货车里。

sentences.en: You just violated their rights.
sentences.zh: 你们刚刚侵犯了他们的权利。

sentences.en: Filled with officers and tactical gear.
sentences.zh: 车里挤满了警察和战术装备。

sentences.en: And what is the response to these videos?
sentences.zh: 那么对这些视频有什么回应呢？

sentences.en: I mean, you've got outrage from not just the protesters, but from the same city officials that have been the target of the protesters all along.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，不仅是抗议者，连一直以来都是抗议者攻击目标的城市官员也感到愤怒。

sentences.en: The tactics that the Trump administration are using on the streets of Portland are abhorrent.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府在波特兰街头使用的战术令人厌恶。

sentences.en: People are being literally scooped off the street into unmarked vans, rental cars, apparently.
sentences.zh: 人们简直是被从街上强行拖进没有标记的货车，甚至是租来的车里。

sentences.en: The mayor has been villain number one for a lot of these protesters as someone who has failed to reform the police department in the ways they want.
sentences.zh: 市长一直是许多抗议者眼中的头号反派，因为他没能按照他们想要的方式改革警察局。

sentences.en: And yet here you have him.
sentences.zh: 然而现在你看看他。

sentences.en: It's not helping the situation at all.
sentences.zh: 这根本无助于解决问题。

sentences.en: They're not wanted here.
sentences.zh: 这里不需要他们。

sentences.en: We haven't asked them here.
sentences.zh: 我们没有邀请他们来。

sentences.en: In fact, we want them to leave.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们希望他们离开。

sentences.en: Asked the federal officers to leave his city, that he doesn't want them here.
sentences.zh: 他要求联邦官员离开他的城市，说他不希望他们待在这里。

sentences.en: He doesn't want them on the streets.
sentences.zh: 他不希望他们出现在街上。

sentences.en: And what they're doing is they are sharply escalating the situation.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的正在急剧升级局势。

sentences.en: Their presence here is actually leading to more violence and more vandalism.
sentences.zh: 他们的存在实际上导致了更多的暴力和破坏行为。

sentences.en: And you have the cycle here of tear gas, things being thrown back and forth.
sentences.zh: 这里陷入了催泪瓦斯和互相投掷物品的循环。

sentences.en: Standoffs where protesters are holding umbrellas and shields made out of pool noodles and plywood.
sentences.zh: 对峙中，抗议者拿着雨伞，用泳池浮棒和胶合板做成的盾牌。

sentences.en: And the officers standing on the other side and in their full tactical gear and helmets and gas masks and a scene of two sides and not much pathway to a resolution in the space between.
sentences.zh: 而警察站在另一边，全副武装，戴着头盔和防毒面具，这是双方对峙的场景，中间没有任何解决问题的途径。

sentences.en: So as of now, it feels like the very thing the federal government is in Portland to try to tamp down is actually escalating in response.
sentences.zh: 所以目前看来，联邦政府来到波特兰试图平息的事情，实际上反而因为他们的介入而升级了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been a significant escalation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这已经是一次重大的升级。

sentences.en: I mean, now we're seeing thousands of people out there.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到有成千上万的人走上街头。

sentences.en: You have people out there coming out for the first time.
sentences.zh: 有些人是第一次出来。

sentences.en: So what was the what was your motivation for coming out?
sentences.zh: 那么你出来的动机是什么？

sentences.en: I want to be at the end of my life and say that I didn't do anything to make them have a better future.
sentences.zh: 我希望在生命尽头时能说，我曾为他们拥有更好的未来做过一点贡献。

sentences.en: I caught up with this grandmother from Eugene, Oregon, who was there and had come up to Portland for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我采访了这位来自俄勒冈州尤金市的祖母，她第一次来到波特兰。

sentences.en: I told her family that she planned to stay on the outskirts to be safe.
sentences.zh: 她告诉家人她打算待在郊区以保安全。

sentences.en: And then while she was there, she was motivated to to keep moving up.
sentences.zh: 但在那里时，她被激励着不断向前推进。

sentences.en: And I caught up with her again and she was right at the front of the federal courthouse.
sentences.zh: 我再次见到她时，她就在联邦法院的最前线。

sentences.en: She's she's a little uneasy watching this unfold, doesn't necessarily agree with the tactics she's watching, but she's staying there.
sentences.zh: 她看着这一切发生感到有些不安，并不一定认同她所看到的战术，但她还是留了下来。

sentences.en: She feels the need that this is a moment to stand up, to do something.
sentences.zh: 她觉得现在是站出来做点什么的时候了。

sentences.en: And she needs to be there.
sentences.zh: 她觉得她必须在那里。

sentences.en: Mike Baker said that the federal presence in Portland has basically made things worse, not better.
sentences.zh: 迈克·贝克说，联邦在波特兰的存在基本上让事情变得更糟，而不是更好。

sentences.en: And it has really created a kind of violent feedback loop between the protesters and these federal officers.
sentences.zh: 它确实在抗议者和这些联邦官员之间制造了一种暴力的反馈循环。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you think about that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是怎么看的。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, whether you listen to the demonstrators, the local officials there or the senior officials with the Department of Homeland Security,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，无论你是听示威者、当地官员还是国土安全部高级官员的说法，

sentences.en: it's clear everyone agrees that the federal presence thus far has not succeeded in terms of bringing an end to the violence that we're seeing,
sentences.zh: 很明显大家都同意，到目前为止，联邦的存在并没有成功地结束我们所看到的暴力，

sentences.en: the unrest that we're seeing at this time.
sentences.zh: 以及我们目前所看到的动荡。

sentences.en: So by that measure, the goal has not been accomplished.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个标准来看，目标并没有实现。

sentences.en: But there is also a question here, you know, for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 但这里还有一个问题，你知道，对于特朗普政府来说，

sentences.en: Is that solely their measure of success?
sentences.zh: 这是他们衡量成功的唯一标准吗？

sentences.en: Is this solely about bringing an end to this unrest?
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是为了结束这种动荡吗？

sentences.en: You know, optics do matter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，视觉效果确实很重要。

sentences.en: And the optics of having agents in camouflage gear and tactical teams in a city led by Democrats, that does send a message.
sentences.zh: 在民主党领导的城市里，让穿着迷彩服的特工和战术小组出现，这确实传递了一个信息。

sentences.en: The radical left-wing mobs agenda take over our cities.
sentences.zh: 激进的左翼暴徒企图接管我们的城市。

sentences.en: And just a couple days ago, the president's reelection campaign actually issued a campaign ad.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，总统的竞选团队实际上发布了一则竞选广告。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden stands with them.
sentences.zh: 而乔·拜登与他们站在一起。

sentences.en: With images that look a lot like that area around the federal courthouse in Portland, displaying images of unrest and individual acts of violence.
sentences.zh: 画面看起来很像波特兰联邦法院周围的区域，展示了动荡和个人暴力行为的图像。

sentences.en: Violent crime exploding.
sentences.zh: 暴力犯罪激增。

sentences.en: Innocent children fatally shot.
sentences.zh: 无辜的孩子被枪杀。

sentences.en: Who will be there to answer the call when your children aren't safe?
sentences.zh: 当你的孩子不再安全时，谁会来响应呼吁？

sentences.en: And at the very end of that ad, they actually lay it out in pretty direct terMs.
sentences.zh: 在那则广告的最后，他们实际上用非常直接的措辞表达了出来。

sentences.en: Text that reads, you won't be safe in Joe Biden's America.
sentences.zh: 文字写着：在乔·拜登的美国，你不会安全。

sentences.en: I'm Donald J.
sentences.zh: 我是唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump, and I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，我批准了这条信息。

sentences.en: You're actually seeing the White House kind of double down here.
sentences.zh: 你实际上看到白宫在这里加倍下注。

sentences.en: I can tell you in Portland, they've done a fantastic job.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，在波特兰，他们做得非常出色。

sentences.en: And say, well, look, they're doing a great job in Portland.
sentences.zh: 并说，好吧，看，他们在波特兰做得很好。

sentences.en: In fact, we're not going to let New York and Chicago and Philadelphia and Detroit and Baltimore and all of these.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们不会让纽约、芝加哥、费城、底特律、巴尔的摩以及所有这些城市。

sentences.en: Oakland is a mess.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰一团糟。

sentences.en: We're not going to let this happen in our country.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让这种情况在我们的国家发生。

sentences.en: All run by liberal Democrats.
sentences.zh: 全都是由自由派民主党人管理的。

sentences.en: Some of these other cities led by Democrats could use the same kind of deployment.
sentences.zh: 其他一些由民主党领导的城市也可以采用同样的部署。

sentences.en: This is worse than Afghanistan by far.
sentences.zh: 这比阿富汗的情况还要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: This is worse than anything anyone's ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这比任何人见过的任何事情都要糟糕。

sentences.en: All run by the same liberal Democrats.
sentences.zh: 全都是由同样的自由派民主党人管理的。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: If Biden got in, that would be true for the country.
sentences.zh: 如果拜登上台，这对整个国家来说都是如此。

sentences.en: The whole country would go to hell.
sentences.zh: 整个国家都会陷入地狱。

sentences.en: So, Zolan, where does this leave us at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么，佐兰，目前我们处于什么境地？

sentences.en: So, it leaves us in this precarious position.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们处于这种岌岌可危的境地。

sentences.en: We know that on the ground in Portland, the presence of federal agents and those officers has increased tension.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在波特兰当地，联邦特工和那些官员的存在加剧了紧张局势。

sentences.en: But to the president, he'd like to see a similar presence in other cities.
sentences.zh: 但对总统来说，他希望在其他城市看到类似的部署。

sentences.en: Zolan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 佐兰，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump announced that he would immediately dispatch federal law enforcement officers to Chicago.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统宣布他将立即向芝加哥派遣联邦执法人员。

sentences.en: The FBI, ATF, DEA, U.S.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局、烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局、缉毒局、美国

sentences.en: Marshal Service, and Homeland Security will together be sending hundreds of skilled law enforcement officers to Chicago to help drive down violent crime.
sentences.zh: 法警局和国土安全部将共同向芝加哥派遣数百名训练有素的执法人员，以帮助打击暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: In Chicago, Mayor Lori Lightfoot said she would not tolerate the kind of federal deployment that has played out in Portland.
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥，市长洛里·莱特富特表示，她绝不容忍在波特兰上演的那种联邦部署。

sentences.en: What we saw the president and the attorney general do in Portland is a travesty.
sentences.zh: 我们看到总统和司法部长在波特兰所做的一切简直是一场闹剧。

sentences.en: A few hours later, Portland's mayor, Ted Wheeler, joined protesters in the streets there.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，波特兰市长泰德·惠勒加入了当地街头的抗议者行列。

sentences.en: He was quickly tear-gassed by federal agents.
sentences.zh: 他很快就被联邦特工发射的催泪瓦斯击中。

sentences.en: He said, without provocation.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是在毫无挑衅的情况下发生的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: It's essential that we wear masks statewide in Ohio to contain the spread of this virus.
sentences.zh: 为了遏制这种病毒的传播，我们在俄亥俄州全境佩戴口罩至关重要。

sentences.en: So, therefore, tomorrow at 6 o'clock, tomorrow night, our mask order for people who are out in public will be extended throughout the state of Ohio.
sentences.zh: 因此，从明天晚上6点开始，我们将把在公共场合佩戴口罩的强制令扩展到俄亥俄州全境。

sentences.en: As the daily death toll from the coronavirus again surpasses 1,000 Americans a day, governors in three more states issued orders requiring masks.
sentences.zh: 随着新冠病毒导致的每日死亡人数再次超过1000名美国人，又有三个州的州长发布了强制佩戴口罩的命令。

sentences.en: Ohio, Indiana, and Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州、印第安纳州和明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: The wearing of the mask plus the social distancing makes a huge, huge difference.
sentences.zh: 佩戴口罩加上保持社交距离会产生巨大、巨大的影响。

sentences.en: The orders came a day after President Trump, who has long resisted wearing masks and at times even disparaged them, made his most forceful call yet for wearing them.
sentences.zh: 这些命令发布的前一天，长期以来一直抵制佩戴口罩、甚至有时贬低口罩的特朗普总统，发出了迄今为止最强烈的佩戴口罩呼吁。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: No city president has ever done this.
sentences.zh: 没有哪位城市总统做过这种事。

sentences.en: Never, never, never.
sentences.zh: 从来没有，从来没有，从来没有。

sentences.en: No Republican president has done this.
sentences.zh: 没有共和党总统做过。

sentences.en: No Democratic president.
sentences.zh: 也没有民主党总统做过。

sentences.en: We have racists and they've existed.
sentences.zh: 我们有种族主义者，他们一直存在。

sentences.en: They've tried to get elected president.
sentences.zh: 他们曾试图当选总统。

sentences.en: He's the first one that has.
sentences.zh: 他是第一个当选的。

sentences.en: During a campaign event on Wednesday, the presumptive Democratic nominee, Joe Biden, called President Trump the first racist to be elected president.
sentences.zh: 在周三的一次竞选活动中，民主党推定提名人乔·拜登称特朗普总统是第一位当选总统的种族主义者。

sentences.en: The way he deals with people based on the color of their skin, their national origin, where they're from, is absolutely sickening.
sentences.zh: 他根据人们的肤色、国籍、出身地来对待他们的方式，简直令人作呕。

sentences.en: In response, historians noted that previous presidents owned enslaved people and were openly raciSt.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，历史学家指出，以前的总统曾拥有奴隶，并且是公开的种族主义者。

sentences.en: And during a news conference, Trump rejected Biden's characterization.
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，特朗普驳斥了拜登的这种定性。

sentences.en: Would you like to respond to Joe Biden, who today described you, you might have heard that, as the first racist to be elected president?
sentences.zh: 您想回应乔·拜登吗？他今天形容您——您可能听说了——是第一位当选总统的种族主义者。

sentences.en: That was his words.
sentences.zh: 那是他的原话。

sentences.en: I've done things that nobody else, and I've said this, and I say it openly, and not a lot of people dispute it.
sentences.zh: 我做过别人没做过的事，我说过这一点，而且我公开说，没多少人对此有异议。

sentences.en: I've done more for black Americans than anybody with the possible exception of Abraham Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 我为美国黑人所做的事情比任何人都多，可能亚伯拉罕·林肯除外。

sentences.en: Nobody has even been close.
sentences.zh: 没有人能与之相比。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的事宜。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否喝得烂醉才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台找到《Wirecutter秀》。
